notes:
Region note: DX9 uEm000/uEm000Base code starts at 0x53F7C0 and uEmSample extends to ~0x72F2D0, i.e. outside the brief's span 0x54B280-0x72B7E0 (span was trimmed 2% at each end by uem_features.py). Features for 0x53F700-0x54B280 and 0x72B7E1-0x72F2D0 were dumped separately (A/dx9_extra_feats*.json) and those functions were treated as group-A class code. code_range values are family-level (uEm000/Base/001/003 share one range, as do uEm008/008_009Base/009).
Vtable: SE->DX9 slot map is identical for all uEnemy-derived classes for SE slots <144 (canonical map, e.g. 53->30, 21->12, 59->36, 125->87); used to fix the uEmSample message-slot misalignment. Beyond uEnemy, class-owned slots align in order (uEm000Base 213 owned SE slots vs DX9 slots 103-280).
Structural: per class DX9 has getDTI, MyDTI::newInstance (UnitAllocator alloc + ctor), ctor, dtor, scalar-deleting dtor; most newInstance and sdd bodies were undefined code (loc_) - 20 functions defined with add_func and named. Dtors named with mangled ??1 form (IDA would turn ~ into _). uEmAppear/uEmRange share sdd 0x49B290 (outside region, untouched); uEmAppear/uEmRange/uEmPushShl ctors are inlined into newInstance/creators. uEmRange is embedded inside uEm000Base (ctor writes uEmRange vtable at +0x8C then calls uEmRange::init 0x729B10, previously misnamed uEmRange::uEmRange).
SE-only: per-class operator new/new[]/delete x4 and usage() (7 x 14 classes) have no DX9 counterpart; debug dispThinkTbl variants absent; many 18-25 B setX state stubs (esp. uEm009Shl 25 of them, uEmSample) inlined; SE-new features (setGrabBlownTrish, setDeltaTimeRate(float,int), setEnemyPlayerHitStop, getCameraPositionLR etc.) unmatched.
ICF: 18-byte setX stubs are merged across classes in DX9; ~29 SE methods map to stubs located in other TUs (0x5A7xxx-0x5D8xxx, 0x6852F0) - recorded medium, not touched. In-region merged stubs (e.g. 0x58AA60 setAppear1 = uEm008_009Base::setMoveF, 0x54DFE0 callbackAttack4/5Em003, 0x5858C0 four routine*Atk) commented only.
Conflicts (kept DX names): ::die (slot 12) is SE kill and ::validateTargetPtrs (slot 31) is SE updatePtr for uEm000Base/uEm003/uEm008/uEm008_009Base/uEm009 - consistent with base uEnemy naming, left for the coordinator; 0x5498D0 'uEm010::setRecoverHand' = SE uEm000Base::setTurn180 and 0x58C770 'uEm010::setAttackIceMC' = SE uEm008_009Base::setJumpUp (both are in group-A vtables only; likely ICF-shared with uEm010 code, so not renamed). Replaced wrong names: 0x57EEC0 newInstance->getTargetEnemyCenterPos, 0x57EFF0 damageMessage7->getNearTargetEnemy, 0x594B20 damageMessage_2->effectMessage, 0x729B10 uEmRange::uEmRange->init. Collision suffixes: uEm000Base::aim_2 (aim(void) @0x541990), uEm000Base::die_2 (real SE die(void) @0x5511C0).
DX-only in regions include 11 8-byte vtable-thunk stubs at 0x55E620-0x55E6C0 and 9 at 0x595760-0x5957E0 (jmp [eax+disp]), 0x57E990-0x57ED40 (CriticalSection helpers; boundary with previous TU uncertain), 0x5937C0 (cResource addRef/release; likely SE setSoundResource, called from grabMessage), 0x540480/0x5404F0 (uEm000 helpers).
Medium-only notes: uEmSample attack/guard/advancingGuard/reversalDamage/grabNear/damageBlown/damageHighTime/footwork are order+propagation matches with DX bodies ~40% of SE size; uEmAppear freeze helpers (0x7287F0/0x728A70/0x728AC0) ambiguous.
